post.description:
Returns a passphrase-encrypted snapshot of the database (messages stay ciphertext). Restore it with the server CLI.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password.

get.description:
Lists the settings the panel may change with their saved values. Secrets and file paths are never included.
**Access:** Server Admin.

patch.description:
Validates every change, writes them into config.toml (comments are kept) and applies live-editable ones immediately. The whole request is rejected if any change is invalid.
**Access:** Server Admin. Owner-only settings need the owner and their password.

post.description:
Wipes every account, message and upload, then stops the process. Cannot be undone; take a backup first.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password and the server domain typed as confirmation.

Limited-use (max_uses > 0) or unlimited (max_uses = 0), with an optional expiry date. Leave `code` empty for a random one.
**Access:** Server Admin.

delete.description:
Codes declared in config.toml cannot be revoked here; remove them from the file.
**Access:** Server Admin.

get.description:
Counts, uptime and registration mode for the admin dashboard.
**Access:** Server Admin.

post.description:
The previous owner stays on as an admin. Needs the owner's password and the confirmation phrase `TRANSFER`.
**Access:** Server Owner.
post.summary: Hand the owner role to another account

post.description:
Deletes all users except the owner, plus channels, messages, files, invites and sessions. Settings in config.toml are kept. Cannot be undone.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password and the phrase `RESET`.

Replaces ALL current data with the contents of a backup made by the panel. Everyone is signed out, including the caller. Cannot be undone; take a backup first.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password, the archive passphrase and the phrase `RESTORE`.

parameters.description: Passphrase chosen when the backup was made
parameters.name: passphrase

post.summary: Create a channel or direct message

delete.summary: Delete or clear a channel/direct message

parameters.description: If true, permanently deletes for all participants (owner required for group channels)
parameters.name: for_both

post.description:
Creates a new Cove user account. Depends on the server's registration mode:
**open** lets anyone sign up, **invite_only** needs a valid invite_code, **closed** refuses everyone.
The very first account on a fresh server is always accepted and becomes the server owner.
**Access:** Public.

403.description: registration closed, invite required, invite not valid or demo server full

429.description: too many sign-ups from this IP (demo mode)

get.description:
Tells clients whether sign-up is open, invite-only or closed, so the register screen can show the right form.
**Access:** Public.

get.summary: Search globally for users by username

parameters.description: Search query to filter by username
parameters.name: q

get.summary: Get presence status for a user

get.description: Returns the semantic version of the Cove backend currently running.
get.summary: Get the current server build version

target.description: e.g. a username or invite code (never a secret)

aes_key_enc.description: Channel AES-256 key encrypted with server KEK

is_private.description: If true, hidden from public search

last_message_ciphertext.description:
Ephemeral, populated in ListUserChannels: the channel's most recent
message, still encrypted — lets the client render a sidebar preview
without a second round-trip. The server never sees the plaintext.

owner_only.description:
OwnerOnly keys change network exposure or session security, so only the
owner (with their password) may touch them.

restart_required.description:
RestartRequired keys are saved to the file but only take effect after a
restart. The others are applied live.

server_role.description: ServerRole is "owner" or "admin" for panel users, empty otherwise.

invite_code.description: InviteCode is required when the server runs in invite-only mode.

demo.description: Demo is true on a public demo instance; clients show a notice that data resets and is not private.

needs_owner.description: NeedsOwner is true on a fresh server: the next account created becomes the owner.

server_role.description: ServerRole is only filled in for the caller's own account (/api/me), never for other users.
